summary: Proposed AI-focused hyperscale data centre campus promoted by ILI Group on Green Belt farmland at North Lanrigg, between Newhouse, Cleland, Chapelhall and Holytown in North Lanarkshire, badged at 400MW. The third of ILI's three 'Stoics' sites (with Cato in Fife and Rufus in East Ayrshire) in a claimed £15bn programme. A Proposal of Application Notice (25/00989/PAN) was lodged with North Lanarkshire Council in September 2025, pre-application exhibitions were held in October-November 2025, and an EIA screening opinion request (26/00595/EIASCR, 'Data Centre Campus Including Grid Connection') was lodged in May 2026 and remained undetermined as of late July 2026. No full planning application had been located as of 2026-07-30.
maturity_explanation: Proposal of Application Notice 25/00989/PAN received by North Lanarkshire Council on 2025-09-12 (PAN 'Comments' decision issued 2025-09-22) with statutory pre-application exhibitions on 2025-10-21 and 2025-11-04; EIA screening opinion request 26/00595/EIASCR received 2026-05-11 and still pending as scraped 2026-07-28 (target decision 2026-08-03). No formal planning application located on the council portal (via PlanIt mirror) as of 2026-07-30, so the project is early development, not a validated application.
anticipated_operational_date: First Stoics phase targeted online by 2027 at 50-100MW per site (developer/press claim across the three-site programme; not specific to Aurelius)

latest_development.headline: EIA screening opinion request 26/00595/EIASCR ('Data Centre Campus Including Grid Connection') lodged with North Lanarkshire Council; undetermined as of late July 2026 with a target decision date of 3 August 2026
